ko.title: 11월까지 남은 두 달: 의회 주도권을 바꿀 수 있는 경선 시즌의 내막

segments.src: With Election Day set for November 3, the fall primary calendar is underway, and Rhode Island and New Hampshire are among the states where voters are now choosing the candidates who will appear on the general-election ballot.
segments.tr: 11월 3일 선거일을 앞두고 가을 경선 일정이 진행 중이며, 로드아일랜드와 뉴햄프셔는 유권자들이 본선 투표 용지에 오를 후보를 선출하고 있는 주들에 포함되어 있습니다.

segments.src: The results are being watched closely well beyond their borders, since both contests offer early signals about which issues are motivating voters as control of Congress hangs in the balance.
segments.tr: 의회 주도권의 향방이 걸려 있는 가운데, 두 지역의 경선 모두 어떤 이슈가 유권자들을 움직이고 있는지에 대한 초기 신호를 제공하므로 그 경계를 넘어선 지역에서도 결과가 예의주시되고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## A Volatile Political Landscape
segments.tr: ## 변동성이 큰 정국

segments.src: Recent public polling suggests Republican candidates are facing a more difficult environment than they hoped for heading into the fall.
segments.tr: 최근 여론조사에 따르면 공화당 후보들은 가을로 접어들며 기대했던 것보다 더 어려운 환경에 처해 있는 것으로 나타났습니다.

segments.src: Several issues appear to be weighing on the party's standing with voters:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 이슈가 유권자들 사이에서 당의 지지도에 부담을 주고 있는 것으로 보입니다:

segments.src: - **The Iran conflict** — Ongoing U.S. military involvement in the Middle East has drawn mixed reactions from voters across the political spectrum, with some polls showing unease about the scope and duration of American engagement.
segments.tr: - **이란 분쟁** — 중동에서의 지속적인 미국 군사 개입은 정치적 스펙트럼 전반에 걸쳐 유권자들로부터 엇갈린 반응을 불러일으켰으며, 일부 여론조사에서는 미국의 개입 범위와 기간에 대한 불안감을 보여주고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Tariffs** — Trade policy remains a point of contention, with business groups and consumers alike voicing concerns about the downstream effects on prices for everyday goods.
segments.tr: - **관세** — 무역 정책은 여전히 논란의 여지가 있는 부분이며, 기업들과 소비자들 모두 생필품 가격에 미칠 파급 효과에 대해 우려를 표명하고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Gas prices** — Fluctuations at the pump continue to be a pocketbook issue that voters cite frequently in surveys about their top concerns.
segments.tr: - **휘발유 가격** — 주유소 가격의 변동은 유권자들이 주요 관심사에 대한 조사에서 자주 언급하는 체감 물가 문제로 계속 남아 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Affordability** — Broader cost-of-living pressures, from housing to groceries, remain a dominant theme in voter sentiment research, and incumbents of both parties are being pressed to explain what they would do differently.
segments.tr: - **물가 부담** — 주거비부터 식료품에 이르기까지 광범위한 생활비 압박은 유권자 심리 조사에서 지배적인 주제로 남아 있으며, 양당의 현역 의원들은 자신들이 무엇을 다르게 할 것인지 설명하라는 압박을 받고 있습니다.

segments.src: Analysts caution that primary-season polling is a snapshot, not a forecast, and that the political mood can shift considerably over the eight-plus weeks remaining before Election Day.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 경선 시즌의 여론조사는 단면일 뿐 예측이 아니며, 선거일까지 남은 8주 이상의 기간 동안 정치적 기류가 상당히 바뀔 수 있다고 경고합니다.

segments.src: Even so, the current data has prompted strategists in both parties to recalibrate their messaging.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 현재의 데이터는 양당의 전략가들로 하여금 메시지를 재조정하도록 만들었습니다.

segments.src: ## What's at Stake in Rhode Island and New Hampshire
segments.tr: ## 로드아일랜드와 뉴햄프셔에 걸린 걸린 한 자루

segments.src: Primary contests like those in Rhode Island and New Hampshire help determine which candidates will carry each party's banner into November.
segments.tr: 로드아일랜드와 뉴햄프셔에서 열리는 경선은 어떤 후보가 11월에 각 당의 깃발을 들고 나설지 결정하는 데 도움을 줍니다.

segments.src: Turnout patterns, margins of victory, and the ideological makeup of the winning candidates can all offer clues about enthusiasm levels heading into the general election.
segments.tr: 투표율 양상, 승리 격차, 승리한 후보들의 이념적 성향은 모두 본선으로 향하는 열기의 수준에 대한 단서를 제공할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Local election officials in both states have emphasized that they expect a smooth voting process and encourage residents to confirm their registration status and polling locations ahead of time.
segments.tr: 두 주의 지역 선거 관리들은 원활한 투표 진행을 예상한다고 강조하며 주민들에게 유권자 등록 상태와 투표소 위치를 미리 확인할 것을 당부했습니다.

segments.src: ## A Path Back for Democrats?
segments.tr: ## 민주당의 탈환 기회?

segments.src: Democratic strategists see an opening.
segments.tr: 민주당 전략가들은 돌파구를 보고 있습니다.

segments.src: Historically, the party that does not hold the White House tends to perform well in midterm-style cycles, and if affordability and cost-of-living concerns remain top of mind for voters, some analysts believe that dynamic could help Democrats in competitive House and Senate races.
segments.tr: 역사적으로 백악관을 차지하지 않은 정당이 중간선거 성격의 주기에서 좋은 성적을 거두는 경향이 있으며, 물가 부담과 생활비 우려가 유권자들의 마음속에 최우선으로 남는다면 일부 분석가들은 이러한 역학 관계가 치열한 하원 및 상원 경선에서 민주당에 도움이 될 수 있다고 믿습니다.

segments.src: Retaking either chamber would require winning a mix of suburban swing districts and a handful of closely contested Senate seats — no small task, and one that will depend heavily on candidate quality, fundraising, and turnout operations in the final stretch.
segments.tr: 어느 한 원이라도 탈환하려면 교외의 경합 지역구와 몇몇 박빙의 상원 의석을 모두 확보해야 하며, 이는 결코 쉬운 과제가 아니며 마지막 피치에서 후보의 역량, 자금 조달, 투표율 제고 작업에 크게 좌우될 것입니다.

segments.src: Republican leaders, for their part, argue that two months is a long time in politics and that the economic picture, along with developments overseas, could look different by early November.
segments.tr: 공화당 지도부는 정치에서 두 달은 긴 시간이며, 경제 상황과 해외 정세가 11월 초쯤에는 달라질 수 있다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Party officials say they are focusing their closing argument on the broader economy and national security.
segments.tr: 당 관계자들은 광범위한 경제와 국가 안보에 마지막 주장을 집중하고 있다고 말합니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로 지켜봐야 할 것

segments.src: As the calendar moves toward November, expect:
segments.tr: 11월로 다가감에 따라 다음 사항을 기대할 수 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. Additional state primaries that will finalize the general-election matchups in contested districts.
segments.tr: 1. 경합 지역구의 본선 대진표를 확정지을 추가적인 주별 경선.

segments.src: 2. Continued economic data releases on inflation, gas prices, and consumer sentiment that could shape the debate over affordability.
segments.tr: 2. 물가 부담에 대한 토론을 형성할 수 있는 인플레이션, 휘발유 가격, 소비자 심리에 대한 지속적인 경제 데이터 발표.

segments.src: 3. Updates on the situation involving Iran, which both parties acknowledge could influence how voters view foreign policy leadership.
segments.tr: 3. 양당 모두 유권자들이 외교 정책 리더십을 평가하는 방식에 영향을 미칠 수 있음을 인정하는 이란 상황 관련 업데이트.

segments.src: 4. A steady stream of new polling as campaigns enter their final push.
segments.tr: 4. 선거운동이 막바지 총력전에 돌입함에 따른 꾸준한 신규 여론조사 발표.

segments.src: Voters in Rhode Island, New Hampshire, and every other state will ultimately decide the outcome.
segments.tr: 로드아일랜드, 뉴햄프셔, 그리고 다른 모든 주의 유권자들이 궁극적으로 결과를 결정할 것입니다.

segments.src: For now, both parties are treating the next two months as a critical window to make their case on the economy, national security, and the day-to-day cost pressures facing American households.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 양당 모두 앞으로의 두 달을 경제, 국가 안보, 그리고 미국 가정이 직면한 일상의 물가 압박에 대해 자신들의 주장을 펼칠 결정적인 기회로 다루고 있습니다.

zh.title: 距离11月还有两个月：深入观察可能改变国会格局的初选季

segments.src: With Election Day set for November 3, the fall primary calendar is underway, and Rhode Island and New Hampshire are among the states where voters are now choosing the candidates who will appear on the general-election ballot.
segments.tr: 随着选举日定于11月3日，秋季初选日程已经展开，罗德岛州和新罕布什尔州等州的选民们正在选择将出现在大选选票上的候选人。

segments.src: The results are being watched closely well beyond their borders, since both contests offer early signals about which issues are motivating voters as control of Congress hangs in the balance.
segments.tr: 这些结果在各自州界之外也受到了密切关注，因为这两场竞选都提供了早期信号，表明在国会控制权悬而未决的情况下，哪些议题正在激励选民。

segments.src: ## A Volatile Political Landscape
segments.tr: ## 动荡的政治格局

segments.src: Recent public polling suggests Republican candidates are facing a more difficult environment than they hoped for heading into the fall.
segments.tr: 近期的民意调查显示，共和党候选人在进入秋季时面临的环境比他们预期的更为困难。

segments.src: Several issues appear to be weighing on the party's standing with voters:
segments.tr: 几个议题似乎正在影响该党在选民中的地位：

segments.src: - **The Iran conflict** — Ongoing U.S. military involvement in the Middle East has drawn mixed reactions from voters across the political spectrum, with some polls showing unease about the scope and duration of American engagement.
segments.tr: - **伊朗冲突** — 美国持续参与中东军事行动引起了各政治派别选民的复杂反应，一些民调显示人们对美国介入的范围和持续时间感到不安。

segments.src: - **Tariffs** — Trade policy remains a point of contention, with business groups and consumers alike voicing concerns about the downstream effects on prices for everyday goods.
segments.tr: - **关税** — 贸易政策仍然是一个争论点，商业团体和消费者都对日常商品价格的连锁反应表示担忧。

segments.src: - **Gas prices** — Fluctuations at the pump continue to be a pocketbook issue that voters cite frequently in surveys about their top concerns.
segments.tr: - **汽油价格** — 加油站价格的波动仍然是选民在调查中经常提到的关于他们最关心问题的钱包议题。

segments.src: - **Affordability** — Broader cost-of-living pressures, from housing to groceries, remain a dominant theme in voter sentiment research, and incumbents of both parties are being pressed to explain what they would do differently.
segments.tr: - **负担能力** — 从住房到食品杂货，更广泛的生活成本压力仍然是选民情绪研究中的主导主题，两党的现任议员都面临压力，需要解释他们将如何做出不同的应对。

segments.src: Analysts caution that primary-season polling is a snapshot, not a forecast, and that the political mood can shift considerably over the eight-plus weeks remaining before Election Day.
segments.tr: 分析人士提醒说，初选期间的民调只是一个快照，而非预测，并且在距离选举日剩下的八周多时间里，政治情绪可能会发生相当大的变化。

segments.src: Even so, the current data has prompted strategists in both parties to recalibrate their messaging.
segments.tr: 即便如此，当前的数据已促使两党的策略家重新调整他们的信息传递。

segments.src: ## What's at Stake in Rhode Island and New Hampshire
segments.tr: ## 罗德岛州和新罕布什尔州的利害关系

segments.src: Primary contests like those in Rhode Island and New Hampshire help determine which candidates will carry each party's banner into November.
segments.tr: 像罗德岛州和新罕布什尔州这样的初选有助于确定哪些候选人将代表各党派进入11月的大选。

segments.src: Turnout patterns, margins of victory, and the ideological makeup of the winning candidates can all offer clues about enthusiasm levels heading into the general election.
segments.tr: 投票模式、获胜优势以及获胜候选人的意识形态构成，都可以为进入大选前的热情程度提供线索。

segments.src: Local election officials in both states have emphasized that they expect a smooth voting process and encourage residents to confirm their registration status and polling locations ahead of time.
segments.tr: 两州的当地选举官员都强调，他们预计投票过程将顺利进行，并鼓励居民提前确认他们的登记状态和投票地点。

segments.src: ## A Path Back for Democrats?
segments.tr: ## 民主党的回归之路？

segments.src: Democratic strategists see an opening.
segments.tr: 民主党策略家看到了机会。

segments.src: Historically, the party that does not hold the White House tends to perform well in midterm-style cycles, and if affordability and cost-of-living concerns remain top of mind for voters, some analysts believe that dynamic could help Democrats in competitive House and Senate races.
segments.tr: 从历史上看，不掌握白宫的政党往往在中期选举周期中表现良好，如果负担能力和生活成本问题仍然是选民最关心的问题，一些分析人士认为这种动态可能有助于民主党在竞争激烈的众议院和参议院竞选中获胜。

segments.src: Retaking either chamber would require winning a mix of suburban swing districts and a handful of closely contested Senate seats — no small task, and one that will depend heavily on candidate quality, fundraising, and turnout operations in the final stretch.
segments.tr: 夺回任何一个议院都需要赢得郊区摇摆选区和少数几个竞争激烈的参议院席位的组合——这绝非易事，且在很大程度上取决于候选人素质、筹款能力以及最后冲刺阶段的投票动员工作。

segments.src: Republican leaders, for their part, argue that two months is a long time in politics and that the economic picture, along with developments overseas, could look different by early November.
segments.tr: 共和党领导人则认为，在政治上两个月是很长的时间，到11月初，经济状况以及海外事态的发展可能会呈现出不同的面貌。

segments.src: Party officials say they are focusing their closing argument on the broader economy and national security.
segments.tr: 党内官员表示，他们正将最后的论点集中在更广泛的经济和国家安全问题上。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来值得关注的内容

segments.src: As the calendar moves toward November, expect:
segments.tr: 随着日程向11月推进，预计会出现以下情况：

segments.src: 1. Additional state primaries that will finalize the general-election matchups in contested districts.
segments.tr: 1. 更多的州初选，这将最终确定竞争选区的大选对决名单。

segments.src: 2. Continued economic data releases on inflation, gas prices, and consumer sentiment that could shape the debate over affordability.
segments.tr: 2. 关于通货膨胀、汽油价格和消费者情绪的持续经济数据发布，这些数据可能会影响关于负担能力的辩论。

segments.src: 3. Updates on the situation involving Iran, which both parties acknowledge could influence how voters view foreign policy leadership.
segments.tr: 3. 关于伊朗局势的最新进展，两党都承认这可能会影响选民如何看待外交政策领导力。

segments.src: 4. A steady stream of new polling as campaigns enter their final push.
segments.tr: 4. 随着竞选进入最后冲刺阶段，将会有源源不断的新民调发布。

segments.src: Voters in Rhode Island, New Hampshire, and every other state will ultimately decide the outcome.
segments.tr: 罗德岛州、新罕布什尔州以及其他所有州的选民最终将决定结果。

segments.src: For now, both parties are treating the next two months as a critical window to make their case on the economy, national security, and the day-to-day cost pressures facing American households.
segments.tr: 目前，两党都将接下来的两个月视为阐述其在经济、国家安全以及美国家庭面临的日常成本压力方面立场的关键窗口期。

segments.tr: कई मुद्दे मतदाताओं के बीच पार्टी की स्थिति पर भारी पड़ते दिख रहे हैं:

segments.src: - **The Iran conflict** — Ongoing U.S. military involvement in the Middle East has drawn mixed reactions from voters across the political spectrum, with some polls showing unease about the scope and duration of American engagement.
segments.tr: - **ईरान संघर्ष** — मध्य पूर्व में चल रहे अमेरिकी सैन्य हस्तक्षेप ने राजनीतिक स्पेक्ट्रम के मतदाताओं से मिश्रित प्रतिक्रियाएं प्राप्त की हैं, कुछ सर्वेक्षणों में अमेरिकी जुड़ाव के दायरे और अवधि के बारे में चिंता दिखाई दे रही है।

segments.src: - **Tariffs** — Trade policy remains a point of contention, with business groups and consumers alike voicing concerns about the downstream effects on prices for everyday goods.
segments.tr: - **टैरिफ** — व्यापार नीति विवाद का एक बिंदु बनी हुई है, जिसमें व्यापारिक समूहों और उपभोक्ताओं दोनों ने रोजमर्रा की वस्तुओं की कीमतों पर पड़ने वाले प्रभावों के बारे में चिंता व्यक्त की है।

segments.src: - **Gas prices** — Fluctuations at the pump continue to be a pocketbook issue that voters cite frequently in surveys about their top concerns.
segments.tr: - **गैस की कीमतें** — पंप पर उतार-चढ़ाव जेब पर असर डालने वाला एक ऐसा मुद्दा बना हुआ है जिसे मतदाता अपनी शीर्ष चिंताओं के बारे में सर्वेक्षणों में अक्सर उद्धृत करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Affordability** — Broader cost-of-living pressures, from housing to groceries, remain a dominant theme in voter sentiment research, and incumbents of both parties are being pressed to explain what they would do differently.
segments.tr: - **सामर्थ्य** — आवास से लेकर किराने के सामान तक, जीवन-यापन की व्यापक लागत का दबाव, मतदाता धारणा अनुसंधान में एक प्रमुख विषय बना हुआ है, और दोनों पार्टियों के मौजूदा पदाधिकारियों पर यह समझाने के लिए दबाव डाला जा रहा है कि वे अलग तरीके से क्या करेंगे।

segments.src: Analysts caution that primary-season polling is a snapshot, not a forecast, and that the political mood can shift considerably over the eight-plus weeks remaining before Election Day.
segments.tr: विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि प्राइमरी-सीज़न का सर्वेक्षण एक स्नैपशॉट है, पूर्वानुमान नहीं, और चुनाव दिवस से पहले बचे आठ सप्ताह से अधिक समय में राजनीतिक मूड काफी बदल सकता है।

segments.src: Even so, the current data has prompted strategists in both parties to recalibrate their messaging.
segments.tr: इसके बावजूद, मौजूदा डेटा ने दोनों पार्टियों के रणनीतिकारों को अपने संदेश को फिर से कैलिब्रेट करने के लिए प्रेरित किया है।

segments.src: ## What's at Stake in Rhode Island and New Hampshire
segments.tr: ## रोड आइलैंड और न्यू हैम्पशायर में क्या दांव पर है

segments.src: Primary contests like those in Rhode Island and New Hampshire help determine which candidates will carry each party's banner into November.
segments.tr: रोड आइलैंड और न्यू हैम्पशायर जैसे प्राइमरी मुकाबले यह निर्धारित करने में मदद करते हैं कि कौन से उम्मीदवार नवंबर में प्रत्येक पार्टी का झंडा उठाएंगे।

segments.src: Turnout patterns, margins of victory, and the ideological makeup of the winning candidates can all offer clues about enthusiasm levels heading into the general election.
segments.tr: मतदान के पैटर्न, जीत का अंतर, और जीतने वाले उम्मीदवारों की वैचारिक बनावट, ये सभी आम चुनाव की ओर बढ़ते हुए उत्साह के स्तर के बारे में संकेत दे सकते हैं।

segments.src: Local election officials in both states have emphasized that they expect a smooth voting process and encourage residents to confirm their registration status and polling locations ahead of time.
segments.tr: दोनों राज्यों के स्थानीय चुनाव अधिकारियों ने जोर देकर कहा है कि वे एक सुचारू मतदान प्रक्रिया की उम्मीद करते हैं और निवासियों को समय से पहले अपनी पंजीकरण स्थिति और मतदान केंद्रों की पुष्टि करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।

segments.src: ## A Path Back for Democrats?
segments.tr: ## डेमोक्रेट्स के लिए वापसी का रास्ता?

segments.src: Democratic strategists see an opening.
segments.tr: डेमोक्रेटिक रणनीतिकार एक अवसर देख रहे हैं।

segments.src: Historically, the party that does not hold the White House tends to perform well in midterm-style cycles, and if affordability and cost-of-living concerns remain top of mind for voters, some analysts believe that dynamic could help Democrats in competitive House and Senate races.
segments.tr: ऐतिहासिक रूप से, जो पार्टी व्हाइट हाउस में नहीं है, वह मध्यावधि-शैली के चक्रों में अच्छा प्रदर्शन करती है, और यदि सामर्थ्य और जीवन-यापन की लागत संबंधी चिंताएं मतदाताओं के दिमाग में सबसे ऊपर रहती हैं, तो कुछ विश्लेषकों का मानना है कि वह गतिशीलता प्रतिस्पर्धी हाउस और सीनेट दौड़ में डेमोक्रेट्स की मदद कर सकती है।

segments.src: Retaking either chamber would require winning a mix of suburban swing districts and a handful of closely contested Senate seats — no small task, and one that will depend heavily on candidate quality, fundraising, and turnout operations in the final stretch.
segments.tr: किसी भी सदन को वापस जीतने के लिए उपनगरीय स्विंग जिलों और कुछ करीबी मुकाबले वाली सीनेट सीटों के मिश्रण को जीतने की आवश्यकता होगी — यह कोई छोटा काम नहीं है, और यह अंतिम चरण में उम्मीदवार की गुणवत्ता, धन उगाहने और मतदान अभियानों पर बहुत अधिक निर्भर करेगा।

segments.src: Republican leaders, for their part, argue that two months is a long time in politics and that the economic picture, along with developments overseas, could look different by early November.
segments.tr: रिपब्लिकन नेताओं का तर्क है कि राजनीति में दो महीने का समय बहुत लंबा होता है और आर्थिक तस्वीर, विदेशों में विकास के साथ, नवंबर की शुरुआत तक अलग दिख सकती है।

segments.src: Party officials say they are focusing their closing argument on the broader economy and national security.
segments.tr: पार्टी अधिकारियों का कहना है कि वे अपनी अंतिम बहस को व्यापक अर्थव्यवस्था और राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा पर केंद्रित कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखना है

segments.src: As the calendar moves toward November, expect:
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे कैलेंडर नवंबर की ओर बढ़ रहा है, उम्मीद करें:

segments.src: 1. Additional state primaries that will finalize the general-election matchups in contested districts.
segments.tr: 1. अतिरिक्त राज्य प्राइमरी जो चुनाव वाले जिलों में आम चुनाव के मुकाबलों को अंतिम रूप देंगे।

segments.src: 2. Continued economic data releases on inflation, gas prices, and consumer sentiment that could shape the debate over affordability.
segments.tr: 2. मुद्रास्फीति, गैस की कीमतों और उपभोक्ता धारणा पर निरंतर आर्थिक डेटा जारी होना जो सामर्थ्य पर बहस को आकार दे सकता है।

segments.src: 3. Updates on the situation involving Iran, which both parties acknowledge could influence how voters view foreign policy leadership.
segments.tr: 3. ईरान से जुड़ी स्थिति पर अपडेट, जिसे दोनों पार्टियां स्वीकार करती हैं कि यह प्रभावित कर सकता है कि मतदाता विदेश नीति के नेतृत्व को कैसे देखते हैं।

segments.src: 4. A steady stream of new polling as campaigns enter their final push.
segments.tr: 4. नए सर्वेक्षणों की एक स्थिर धारा जैसे-जैसे अभियान अपने अंतिम जोर में प्रवेश करेंगे।

segments.src: Voters in Rhode Island, New Hampshire, and every other state will ultimately decide the outcome.
segments.tr: रोड आइलैंड, न्यू हैम्पशायर और अन्य सभी राज्यों के मतदाता अंततः परिणाम तय करेंगे।

segments.src: For now, both parties are treating the next two months as a critical window to make their case on the economy, national security, and the day-to-day cost pressures facing American households.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, दोनों पार्टियां अगले दो महीनों को अर्थव्यवस्था, राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा और अमेरिकी परिवारों के सामने आने वाले दैनिक लागत दबावों पर अपना पक्ष रखने के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण खिड़की के रूप में देख रही हैं।

es.title: Dos meses para noviembre: un vistazo a la temporada de primarias que podría cambiar el Congreso

segments.src: With Election Day set for November 3, the fall primary calendar is underway, and Rhode Island and New Hampshire are among the states where voters are now choosing the candidates who will appear on the general-election ballot.
segments.tr: Con el día de las elecciones fijado para el 3 de noviembre, el calendario de primarias de otoño está en marcha, y Rhode Island y New Hampshire se encuentran entre los estados donde los votantes están eligiendo ahora a los candidatos que aparecerán en la boleta de las elecciones generales.

segments.src: The results are being watched closely well beyond their borders, since both contests offer early signals about which issues are motivating voters as control of Congress hangs in the balance.
segments.tr: Los resultados se observan de cerca mucho más allá de sus fronteras, ya que ambas contiendas ofrecen señales tempranas sobre qué temas están motivando a los votantes mientras el control del Congreso está en juego.

segments.src: ## A Volatile Political Landscape
segments.tr: ## Un panorama político volátil

segments.src: Recent public polling suggests Republican candidates are facing a more difficult environment than they hoped for heading into the fall.
segments.tr: Las encuestas públicas recientes sugieren que los candidatos republicanos se enfrentan a un entorno más difícil de lo que esperaban de cara al otoño.

segments.src: Several issues appear to be weighing on the party's standing with voters:
segments.tr: Varios temas parecen estar afectando la posición del partido ante los votantes:

segments.src: - **The Iran conflict** — Ongoing U.S. military involvement in the Middle East has drawn mixed reactions from voters across the political spectrum, with some polls showing unease about the scope and duration of American engagement.
segments.tr: - **El conflicto de Irán** — La continua participación militar de EE. UU. en Oriente Medio ha provocado reacciones mixtas de los votantes en todo el espectro político, con algunas encuestas que muestran inquietud sobre el alcance y la duración del compromiso estadounidense.

segments.src: - **Tariffs** — Trade policy remains a point of contention, with business groups and consumers alike voicing concerns about the downstream effects on prices for everyday goods.
segments.tr: - **Aranceles** — La política comercial sigue siendo un punto de disputa, con grupos empresariales y consumidores expresando preocupaciones sobre los efectos secundarios en los precios de los bienes cotidianos.

segments.src: - **Gas prices** — Fluctuations at the pump continue to be a pocketbook issue that voters cite frequently in surveys about their top concerns.
segments.tr: - **Precios de la gasolina** — Las fluctuaciones en el surtidor siguen siendo un problema de bolsillo que los votantes citan con frecuencia en las encuestas sobre sus principales preocupaciones.

segments.src: - **Affordability** — Broader cost-of-living pressures, from housing to groceries, remain a dominant theme in voter sentiment research, and incumbents of both parties are being pressed to explain what they would do differently.
segments.tr: - **Asequibilidad** — Las presiones más amplias sobre el costo de vida, desde la vivienda hasta los comestibles, siguen siendo un tema dominante en la investigación del sentimiento de los votantes, y los titulares de ambos partidos están siendo presionados para explicar qué harían de manera diferente.

segments.src: Analysts caution that primary-season polling is a snapshot, not a forecast, and that the political mood can shift considerably over the eight-plus weeks remaining before Election Day.
segments.tr: Los analistas advierten que las encuestas de la temporada de primarias son una instantánea, no un pronóstico, y que el estado de ánimo político puede cambiar considerablemente durante las más de ocho semanas que quedan antes del día de las elecciones.

segments.src: Even so, the current data has prompted strategists in both parties to recalibrate their messaging.
segments.tr: Aun así, los datos actuales han llevado a los estrategas de ambos partidos a recalibrar sus mensajes.

segments.tr: ## Qué está en juego en Rhode Island y New Hampshire

segments.tr: Los funcionarios electorales locales en ambos estados han enfatizado que esperan un proceso de votación sin problemas y alientan a los residentes a confirmar su estado de registro y sus lugares de votación con anticipación.

segments.src: ## A Path Back for Democrats?
segments.tr: ## ¿Un camino de regreso para los demócratas?

segments.tr: Los estrategas demócratas ven una oportunidad.

segments.src: Analysts caution that primary-season polling is a snapshot, not a forecast, and that the political mood can shift considerably over the eight-plus weeks remaining before Election Day.
segments.tr: يحذر المحللون من أن استطلاعات الرأي في موسم الانتخابات التمهيدية هي لقطة وليست توقعاً، وأن المزاج السياسي يمكن أن يتغير بشكل كبير خلال الأسابيع الثمانية أو أكثر المتبقية قبل يوم الانتخابات.

segments.src: Even so, the current data has prompted strategists in both parties to recalibrate their messaging.

segments.src: ## What's at Stake in Rhode Island and New Hampshire

segments.src: Local election officials in both states have emphasized that they expect a smooth voting process and encourage residents to confirm their registration status and polling locations ahead of time.

segments.src: ## A Path Back for Democrats?
segments.tr: ## طريق العودة للديمقراطيين؟

segments.src: Historically, the party that does not hold the White House tends to perform well in midterm-style cycles, and if affordability and cost-of-living concerns remain top of mind for voters, some analysts believe that dynamic could help Democrats in competitive House and Senate races.
segments.tr: تاريخياً، يميل الحزب الذي لا يشغل البيت الأبيض إلى الأداء الجيد في دورات نمط الانتخابات النصفية، وإذا ظلت مخاوف القدرة على تحمل التكاليف وتكلفة المعيشة في صدارة أذهان الناخبين، يعتقد بعض المحللين أن هذه الديناميكية قد تساعد الديمقراطيين في سباقات مجلسي النواب والشيوخ التنافسية.

segments.src: Retaking either chamber would require winning a mix of suburban swing districts and a handful of closely contested Senate seats — no small task, and one that will depend heavily on candidate quality, fundraising, and turnout operations in the final stretch.
segments.tr: ستتطلب استعادة أي من الغرفتين الفوز بمزيج من مناطق الضواحي المتأرجحة وعدد قليل من مقاعد مجلس الشيوخ المتنازع عليها بشدة - وهي ليست بالمهمة السهلة، وستعتمد بشكل كبير على جودة المرشحين، وجمع التبرعات، وعمليات الإقبال في المرحلة الأخيرة.

segments.src: Republican leaders, for their part, argue that two months is a long time in politics and that the economic picture, along with developments overseas, could look different by early November.

segments.src: Party officials say they are focusing their closing argument on the broader economy and national security.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next

segments.src: 3. Updates on the situation involving Iran, which both parties acknowledge could influence how voters view foreign policy leadership.
segments.tr: 3. التحديثات حول الوضع المتعلق بإيران، والذي يقر كلا الحزبين بأنه قد يؤثر على كيفية نظر الناخبين إلى القيادة في مجال السياسة الخارجية.

segments.src: 4. A steady stream of new polling as campaigns enter their final push.
segments.tr: 4. تدفق ثابت لاستطلاعات الرأي الجديدة مع دخول الحملات دفعتها الأخيرة.

segments.src: Voters in Rhode Island, New Hampshire, and every other state will ultimately decide the outcome.

segments.src: For now, both parties are treating the next two months as a critical window to make their case on the economy, national security, and the day-to-day cost pressures facing American households.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، يتعامل كلا الحزبين مع الشهرين القادمين نافذة حاسمة لعرض قضيتهم حول الاقتصاد، والأمن القومي، وضغوط التكلفة اليومية التي تواجه الأسر الأمريكية.

fr.title: Deux mois avant novembre : dans les coulisses de la saison des primaires qui pourrait renverser le Congrès

segments.src: With Election Day set for November 3, the fall primary calendar is underway, and Rhode Island and New Hampshire are among the states where voters are now choosing the candidates who will appear on the general-election ballot.
segments.tr: Le jour de l'élection étant fixé au 3 novembre, le calendrier des primaires d'automne est en cours, et le Rhode Island et le New Hampshire font partie des États où les électeurs choisissent actuellement les candidats qui figureront sur le bulletin de vote de l'élection générale.

segments.src: The results are being watched closely well beyond their borders, since both contests offer early signals about which issues are motivating voters as control of Congress hangs in the balance.
segments.tr: Les résultats sont suivis de près bien au-delà de leurs frontières, car les deux scrutins offrent des signaux précoces sur les questions qui motivent les électeurs alors que le contrôle du Congrès est en balance.

segments.src: ## A Volatile Political Landscape
segments.tr: ## Un paysage politique volatil

segments.src: Recent public polling suggests Republican candidates are facing a more difficult environment than they hoped for heading into the fall.
segments.tr: Les sondages publics récents suggèrent que les candidats républicains font face à un environnement plus difficile qu'ils ne l'espéraient à l'approche de l'automne.

segments.src: Several issues appear to be weighing on the party's standing with voters:
segments.tr: Plusieurs questions semblent peser sur la position du parti auprès des électeurs :

segments.src: - **The Iran conflict** — Ongoing U.S. military involvement in the Middle East has drawn mixed reactions from voters across the political spectrum, with some polls showing unease about the scope and duration of American engagement.
segments.tr: - **Le conflit iranien** — L'implication militaire américaine en cours au Moyen-Orient a suscité des réactions mitigées de la part des électeurs de tout l'échiquier politique, certains sondages montrant une inquiétude quant à l'ampleur et à la durée de l'engagement américain.

segments.src: - **Tariffs** — Trade policy remains a point of contention, with business groups and consumers alike voicing concerns about the downstream effects on prices for everyday goods.
segments.tr: - **Les tarifs douaniers** — La politique commerciale reste un point de contention, les groupes professionnels et les consommateurs exprimant des inquiétudes quant aux répercussions sur les prix des biens de tous les jours.

segments.src: - **Gas prices** — Fluctuations at the pump continue to be a pocketbook issue that voters cite frequently in surveys about their top concerns.
segments.tr: - **Les prix de l'essence** — Les fluctuations à la pompe continuent d'être une préoccupation financière que les électeurs citent fréquemment dans les sondages concernant leurs principales inquiétudes.

segments.src: - **Affordability** — Broader cost-of-living pressures, from housing to groceries, remain a dominant theme in voter sentiment research, and incumbents of both parties are being pressed to explain what they would do differently.
segments.tr: - **L'accessibilité financière** — Des pressions plus larges sur le coût de la vie, du logement aux produits d'épicerie, restent un thème dominant dans la recherche sur le sentiment des électeurs, et les sortants des deux partis sont poussés à expliquer ce qu'ils feraient différemment.

segments.src: Analysts caution that primary-season polling is a snapshot, not a forecast, and that the political mood can shift considerably over the eight-plus weeks remaining before Election Day.
segments.tr: Les analystes préviennent que les sondages de la saison des primaires sont un instantané, et non une prévision, et que l'humeur politique peut changer considérablement au cours des plus de huit semaines restant avant le jour de l'élection.

segments.src: Even so, the current data has prompted strategists in both parties to recalibrate their messaging.
segments.tr: Malgré tout, les données actuelles ont incité les stratégistes des deux partis à recalibrer leur message.

segments.src: ## What's at Stake in Rhode Island and New Hampshire
segments.tr: ## Ce qui est en jeu au Rhode Island et dans le New Hampshire

segments.src: Primary contests like those in Rhode Island and New Hampshire help determine which candidates will carry each party's banner into November.
segments.tr: Les scrutins primaires comme ceux du Rhode Island et du New Hampshire aident à déterminer quels candidats porteront la bannière de chaque parti en novembre.

segments.src: Turnout patterns, margins of victory, and the ideological makeup of the winning candidates can all offer clues about enthusiasm levels heading into the general election.
segments.tr: Les modèles de participation, les marges de victoire et la composition idéologique des candidats gagnants peuvent tous offrir des indices sur les niveaux d'enthousiasme à l'approche de l'élection générale.

segments.src: Local election officials in both states have emphasized that they expect a smooth voting process and encourage residents to confirm their registration status and polling locations ahead of time.
segments.tr: Les responsables électoraux locaux dans les deux États ont souligné qu'ils s'attendent à un processus de vote fluide et encouragent les résidents à confirmer leur statut d'inscription et leurs bureaux devote à l'avance.

segments.src: ## A Path Back for Democrats?
segments.tr: ## Une voie de retour pour les démocrates ?

segments.src: Democratic strategists see an opening.
segments.tr: Les stratégistes démocrates voient une opportunité.

segments.src: Historically, the party that does not hold the White House tends to perform well in midterm-style cycles, and if affordability and cost-of-living concerns remain top of mind for voters, some analysts believe that dynamic could help Democrats in competitive House and Senate races.
segments.tr: Historiquement, le parti qui ne détient pas la Maison-Blanche a tendance à bien performer dans les cycles de type mi-mandat, et si l'accessibilité financière et les préoccupations liées au coût de la vie restent au premier plan pour les électeurs, certains analystes pensent que cette dynamique pourrait aider les démocrates dans les courses compétitives à la Chambre et au Sénat.

segments.src: Retaking either chamber would require winning a mix of suburban swing districts and a handful of closely contested Senate seats — no small task, and one that will depend heavily on candidate quality, fundraising, and turnout operations in the final stretch.
segments.tr: Reprendre l'une ou l'autre chambre exigerait de remporter un mélange de districts bascules de banlieue et une poignée de sièges au Sénat âprement disputés — ce n'est pas une mince affaire, et cela dépendra fortement de la qualité des candidats, de la collecte de fonds et des opérations de mobilisation dans la dernière ligne droite.

segments.src: Republican leaders, for their part, argue that two months is a long time in politics and that the economic picture, along with developments overseas, could look different by early November.
segments.tr: Les dirigeants républicains, quant à eux, soutiennent que deux mois c'est long en politique et que le tableau économique, ainsi que les développements à l'étranger, pourraient être différents d'ici début novembre.

segments.src: Party officials say they are focusing their closing argument on the broader economy and national security.
segments.tr: Les responsables du parti affirment qu'ils concentrent leur argumentaire final sur l'économie globale et la sécurité nationale.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller ensuite

segments.tr: Alors que le calendrier avance vers novembre, attendez-vous à :

segments.src: 1. Additional state primaries that will finalize the general-election matchups in contested districts.
segments.tr: 1. D'autres primaires d'État qui finaliseront les affichages des élections générales dans les districts contestés.

segments.src: 2. Continued economic data releases on inflation, gas prices, and consumer sentiment that could shape the debate over affordability.
segments.tr: 2. La publication continue de données économiques sur l'inflation, les prix de l'essence et le sentiment des consommateurs qui pourraient façonner le débat sur l'accessibilité financière.

segments.src: 3. Updates on the situation involving Iran, which both parties acknowledge could influence how voters view foreign policy leadership.
segments.tr: 3. Des mises à jour sur la situation concernant l'Iran, ce que les deux partis reconnaissent pourrait influencer la façon dont les électeurs perçoivent le leadership en matière de politique étrangère.

segments.src: 4. A steady stream of new polling as campaigns enter their final push.
segments.tr: 4. Un flux régulier de nouveaux sondages alors que les campagnes entrent dans leur dernière ligne droite.

segments.src: Voters in Rhode Island, New Hampshire, and every other state will ultimately decide the outcome.
segments.tr: Les électeurs du Rhode Island, du New Hampshire et de tous les autres États décideront finalement de l'issue.

segments.src: For now, both parties are treating the next two months as a critical window to make their case on the economy, national security, and the day-to-day cost pressures facing American households.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, les deux partis traitent les deux prochains mois comme une fenêtre critique pour faire valoir leurs arguments sur l'économie, la sécurité nationale et les pressions quotidiennes sur les coûts auxquelles font face les ménages américains.

segments.src: Several issues appear to be weighing on the party's standing with voters:
segments.tr: Beberapa isu tampaknya menekan posisi partai di mata pemilih:

segments.src: - **The Iran conflict** — Ongoing U.S. military involvement in the Middle East has drawn mixed reactions from voters across the political spectrum, with some polls showing unease about the scope and duration of American engagement.
segments.tr: - **Konflik Iran** — Keterlibatan militer U.S. yang terus berlanjut di Timur Tengah menuai reaksi beragam dari pemilih di seluruh spektrum politik, dengan beberapa jajak pendapat menunjukkan keresahan tentang cakupan dan durasi keterlibatan Amerika.

segments.src: - **Tariffs** — Trade policy remains a point of contention, with business groups and consumers alike voicing concerns about the downstream effects on prices for everyday goods.
segments.tr: - **Tarif** — Kebijakan perdagangan tetap menjadi titik perdebatan, dengan kelompok bisnis dan konsumen sama-sama menyuarakan kekhawatiran tentang efek lanjutan terhadap harga barang sehari-hari.

segments.src: - **Gas prices** — Fluctuations at the pump continue to be a pocketbook issue that voters cite frequently in surveys about their top concerns.
segments.tr: - **Harga bensin** — Fluktuasi harga di SPBU terus menjadi masalah keuangan pribadi yang sering dikutip pemilih dalam survei tentang perhatian utama mereka.

segments.src: - **Affordability** — Broader cost-of-living pressures, from housing to groceries, remain a dominant theme in voter sentiment research, and incumbents of both parties are being pressed to explain what they would do differently.
segments.tr: - **Keterjangkauan** — Tekanan biaya hidup yang lebih luas, dari perumahan hingga bahan makanan, tetap menjadi tema dominan dalam penelitian sentimen pemilih, dan petahana dari kedua partai didesak untuk menjelaskan apa yang akan mereka lakukan secara berbeda.

segments.src: Analysts caution that primary-season polling is a snapshot, not a forecast, and that the political mood can shift considerably over the eight-plus weeks remaining before Election Day.
segments.tr: Para analis mengingatkan bahwa jajak pendapat musim primary adalah potret sesaat, bukan prakiraan, dan suasana politik dapat berubah secara signifikan selama delapan minggu lebih yang tersisa sebelum Hari Pemilihan.

segments.src: Even so, the current data has prompted strategists in both parties to recalibrate their messaging.
segments.tr: Meskipun demikian, data saat ini telah mendorong para ahli strategi di kedua partai untuk mengkalibrasi ulang pesan mereka.

segments.src: ## What's at Stake in Rhode Island and New Hampshire
segments.tr: ## Taruhan di Rhode Island dan New Hampshire

segments.src: Primary contests like those in Rhode Island and New Hampshire help determine which candidates will carry each party's banner into November.
segments.tr: Kontestasi primary seperti yang ada di Rhode Island dan New Hampshire membantu menentukan kandidat mana yang akan membawa bendera masing-masing partai menuju bulan November.

segments.src: Turnout patterns, margins of victory, and the ideological makeup of the winning candidates can all offer clues about enthusiasm levels heading into the general election.
segments.tr: Pola partisipasi pemilih, margin kemenangan, dan komposisi ideologis dari kandidat yang menang semuanya dapat memberikan petunjuk tentang tingkat antusiasme menjelang pemilihan umum.

segments.src: Local election officials in both states have emphasized that they expect a smooth voting process and encourage residents to confirm their registration status and polling locations ahead of time.
segments.tr: Pejabat pemilu lokal di kedua negara bagian telah menekankan bahwa mereka mengharapkan proses pemungutan suara yang lancar dan mendorong warga untuk mengonfirmasi status pendaftaran serta lokasi pemungutan suara mereka terlebih dahulu.

segments.src: ## A Path Back for Democrats?
segments.tr: ## Jalan Kembali bagi Partai Demokrat?

segments.src: Democratic strategists see an opening.
segments.tr: Para ahli strategi Partai Demokrat melihat adanya peluang.

segments.src: Historically, the party that does not hold the White House tends to perform well in midterm-style cycles, and if affordability and cost-of-living concerns remain top of mind for voters, some analysts believe that dynamic could help Democrats in competitive House and Senate races.
segments.tr: Secara historis, partai yang tidak memegang Gedung Putih cenderung tampil baik dalam siklus bergaya paruh waktu, dan jika kekhawatiran keterjangkauan dan biaya hidup tetap menjadi perhatian utama para pemilih, beberapa analis percaya dinamika tersebut dapat membantu Partai Demokrat dalam persaingan DPR dan Senat yang kompetitif.

segments.src: Retaking either chamber would require winning a mix of suburban swing districts and a handful of closely contested Senate seats — no small task, and one that will depend heavily on candidate quality, fundraising, and turnout operations in the final stretch.
segments.tr: Merebut kembali salah satu majelis akan membutuhkan kemenangan di campuran distrik swing pinggiran kota dan sejumlah kursi Senat yang diperebutkan dengan ketat — bukan tugas kecil, dan tugas yang sangat bergantung pada kualitas kandidat, penggalangan dana, serta operasi partisipasi pemilih di putaran akhir.

segments.src: Republican leaders, for their part, argue that two months is a long time in politics and that the economic picture, along with developments overseas, could look different by early November.
segments.tr: Pemimpin Partai Republik, di sisi lain, berargumen bahwa dua bulan adalah waktu yang lama dalam politik dan bahwa gambaran ekonomi, bersama dengan perkembangan di luar negeri, bisa terlihat berbeda pada awal November.

segments.src: Party officials say they are focusing their closing argument on the broader economy and national security.
segments.tr: Pejabat partai mengatakan mereka memfokuskan argumen penutup mereka pada ekonomi secara lebih luas dan keamanan nasional.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Hal yang Perlu Diperhatikan Selanjutnya

segments.src: As the calendar moves toward November, expect:
segments.tr: Saat kalender bergerak menuju November, nantikan:

segments.src: 1. Additional state primaries that will finalize the general-election matchups in contested districts.
segments.tr: 1. Primary negara bagian tambahan yang akan memfinalisasi pertarungan pemilihan umum di distrik-distrik yang diperebutkan.

segments.src: 2. Continued economic data releases on inflation, gas prices, and consumer sentiment that could shape the debate over affordability.
segments.tr: 2. Rilis data ekonomi yang berlanjut tentang inflasi, harga bensin, dan sentimen konsumen yang dapat membentuk perdebatan tentang keterjangkauan.

segments.src: 3. Updates on the situation involving Iran, which both parties acknowledge could influence how voters view foreign policy leadership.
segments.tr: 3. Pembaruan tentang situasi yang melibatkan Iran, yang diakui oleh kedua partai dapat memengaruhi cara pemilih memandang kepemimpinan kebijakan luar negeri.

segments.src: 4. A steady stream of new polling as campaigns enter their final push.
segments.tr: 4. Aliran jajak pendapat baru yang stabil saat kampanye memasuki dorongan terakhir mereka.

segments.src: Voters in Rhode Island, New Hampshire, and every other state will ultimately decide the outcome.
segments.tr: Pemilih di Rhode Island, New Hampshire, dan setiap negara bagian lainnya pada akhirnya akan menentukan hasilnya.

segments.src: For now, both parties are treating the next two months as a critical window to make their case on the economy, national security, and the day-to-day cost pressures facing American households.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, kedua partai memperlakukan dua bulan ke depan sebagai jendela krusial untuk menyampaikan argumen mereka tentang ekonomi, keamanan nasional, dan tekanan biaya sehari-hari yang dihadapi rumah tangga Amerika.

segments.src: ## A Volatile Political Landscape
segments.tr: ## 流動的な政治情勢

segments.src: Recent public polling suggests Republican candidates are facing a more difficult environment than they hoped for heading into the fall.
segments.tr: 最近の世論調査によると、共和党の候補者は秋に向けて予想していたよりも厳しい情勢に直面していることが示唆されています。

segments.src: Several issues appear to be weighing on the party's standing with voters:
segments.tr: いくつかの課題が、有権者の間での同党の支持に影響を与えているようです：

segments.src: - **The Iran conflict** — Ongoing U.S. military involvement in the Middle East has drawn mixed reactions from voters across the political spectrum, with some polls showing unease about the scope and duration of American engagement.
segments.tr: - **イラン紛争** — 中東における継続的な米軍の関与は、政治的立場の異なる有権者から賛否両論の反応を引き起こしており、一部の世論調査ではアメリカの関与の範囲と期間に対する不安が示されています。

segments.src: - **Tariffs** — Trade policy remains a point of contention, with business groups and consumers alike voicing concerns about the downstream effects on prices for everyday goods.
segments.tr: - **関税** — 貿易政策は引き続き論争の的となっており、ビジネス団体や消費者の双方が日用品の価格への波及効果に懸念を表明しています。

segments.src: - **Gas prices** — Fluctuations at the pump continue to be a pocketbook issue that voters cite frequently in surveys about their top concerns.
segments.tr: - **ガソリン価格** — ガソリンスタンドでの価格変動は、有権者が最大の懸念事項として調査で頻繁に挙げる家計の問題であり続けています。

segments.src: - **Affordability** — Broader cost-of-living pressures, from housing to groceries, remain a dominant theme in voter sentiment research, and incumbents of both parties are being pressed to explain what they would do differently.
segments.tr: - **生活費の負担** — 住宅から食料品に至るまで、より広範な生活費の圧迫は有権者感情調査において依然として支配的なテーマであり、両党の現職議員はどのような対策をとるか説明を求められています。

segments.src: Analysts caution that primary-season polling is a snapshot, not a forecast, and that the political mood can shift considerably over the eight-plus weeks remaining before Election Day.
segments.tr: アナリストらは、予備選シーズンの世論調査はあくまで現状のスケッチであり予測ではないこと、そして投票日までの8週間余りの間に政治的な気運が大きく変化する可能性があることを警告しています。

segments.src: Even so, the current data has prompted strategists in both parties to recalibrate their messaging.
segments.tr: それでもなお、現在のデータによって両党の戦略担当者はメッセージの再調整を余儀なくされています。

segments.src: ## What's at Stake in Rhode Island and New Hampshire
segments.tr: ## ロードアイランド州とニューハンプシャー州で何が懸かっているのか

segments.src: Primary contests like those in Rhode Island and New Hampshire help determine which candidates will carry each party's banner into November.
segments.tr: ロードアイランド州やニューハンプシャー州のような予備選は、どの候補者が各党の代表として11月の本選に臨むかを決定するのに役立ちます。

segments.src: Local election officials in both states have emphasized that they expect a smooth voting process and encourage residents to confirm their registration status and polling locations ahead of time.
segments.tr: 両州の地元の選挙管理職人は、円滑な投票プロセスを期待していることを強調し、住民に対して事前に有権者登録の状況と投票所を確認するよう呼びかけています。

segments.src: ## A Path Back for Democrats?
segments.tr: ## 民主党の奪還への道筋？

segments.src: Democratic strategists see an opening.
segments.tr: 民主党の戦略担当者は好機と見ています。

segments.src: Historically, the party that does not hold the White House tends to perform well in midterm-style cycles, and if affordability and cost-of-living concerns remain top of mind for voters, some analysts believe that dynamic could help Democrats in competitive House and Senate races.
segments.tr: 歴史的に、ホワイトハウスを保持していない政党は中間選挙スタイルの周期で善戦する傾向があり、生活費や家計の懸念が有権者の最優先事項であり続ければ、その動向が接戦の下院および上院の選挙で民主党に有利に働く可能性があると分析するアナリストもいます。

segments.src: Retaking either chamber would require winning a mix of suburban swing districts and a handful of closely contested Senate seats — no small task, and one that will depend heavily on candidate quality, fundraising, and turnout operations in the final stretch.
segments.tr: いずれかの議院を奪還するには、郊外の激戦区といくつかの僅差の上院議席を組み合わせて勝利する必要があり、これは決して容易なことではありません。最終盤における候補者の資質、資金調達、そして投票呼びかけ運動（ターナウト）に大きく依存することになります。

segments.src: Republican leaders, for their part, argue that two months is a long time in politics and that the economic picture, along with developments overseas, could look different by early November.

segments.src: Party officials say they are focusing their closing argument on the broader economy and national security.

segments.tr: 4. 選挙運動がラストスパートに入る中での、新しい世論調査の絶え間ない発表。

segments.src: Voters in Rhode Island, New Hampshire, and every other state will ultimately decide the outcome.

segments.src: For now, both parties are treating the next two months as a critical window to make their case on the economy, national security, and the day-to-day cost pressures facing American households.

segments.src: Voters in Rhode Island, New Hampshire, and every other state will ultimately decide the outcome.
segments.tr: Die Wähler in Rhode Island, New Hampshire und allen anderen Bundesstaaten werden letztendlich über das Ergebnis entscheiden.

segments.src: For now, both parties are treating the next two months as a critical window to make their case on the economy, national security, and the day-to-day cost pressures facing American households.
segments.tr: Derzeit betrachten beide Parteien die nächsten zwei Monate als entscheidendes Zeitfenster, um ihre Argumente zur Wirtschaft, zur nationalen Sicherheit und zu den täglichen Kostenbelastungen der amerikanischen Haushalte vorzubringen.

vi.title: Hai tháng trước tháng 11: Bên trong Mùa Sơ bộ Có Thể Lật Ngược Quốc hội

segments.src: With Election Day set for November 3, the fall primary calendar is underway, and Rhode Island and New Hampshire are among the states where voters are now choosing the candidates who will appear on the general-election ballot.
segments.tr: Với Ngày Bầu cử được ấn định vào ngày 3 tháng 11, lịch bầu cử sơ bộ mùa thu đang diễn ra, và Đảo Rhode cùng New Hampshire là những bang mà cử tri hiện đang lựa chọn các ứng cử viên sẽ xuất hiện trên lá phiếu tổng tuyển cử.

segments.src: The results are being watched closely well beyond their borders, since both contests offer early signals about which issues are motivating voters as control of Congress hangs in the balance.
segments.tr: Kết quả đang được theo dõi chặt chẽ vượt ra ngoài biên giới của họ, vì cả hai cuộc đua đều đưa ra những tín hiệu sớm về những vấn đề nào đang thúc đẩy cử tri khi quyền kiểm soát Quốc hội vẫn còn đang bỏ ngỏ.

segments.src: ## A Volatile Political Landscape
segments.tr: ## Một Bức Tranh Chính Trị Biến Động

segments.src: Recent public polling suggests Republican candidates are facing a more difficult environment than they hoped for heading into the fall.
segments.tr: Các cuộc thăm dò công khai gần đây cho thấy các ứng cử viên Đảng Cộng hòa đang phải đối mặt với một môi trường khó khăn hơn họ hy vọng khi bước vào mùa thu.

segments.src: Several issues appear to be weighing on the party's standing with voters:
segments.tr: Một số vấn đề dường như đang ảnh hưởng đến vị thế của đảng đối với cử tri:

segments.src: - **The Iran conflict** — Ongoing U.S. military involvement in the Middle East has drawn mixed reactions from voters across the political spectrum, with some polls showing unease about the scope and duration of American engagement.
segments.tr: - **The Iran conflict** — Sự tham gia quân sự liên tục của Hoa Kỳ tại Trung Đông đã thu hút nhiều phản ứng trái chiều từ các cử tri trên khắp phổ chính trị, với một số cuộc thăm dò cho thấy sự bất an về phạm vi và thời gian của sự dấn thân từ phía Mỹ.

segments.src: - **Tariffs** — Trade policy remains a point of contention, with business groups and consumers alike voicing concerns about the downstream effects on prices for everyday goods.
segments.tr: - **Tariffs** — Chính sách thương mại vẫn là một điểm tranh cãi, với cả các nhóm doanh nghiệp và người tiêu dùng đều bày tỏ lo ngại về tác động dây chuyền đối với giá cả hàng hóa hàng ngày.

segments.src: - **Gas prices** — Fluctuations at the pump continue to be a pocketbook issue that voters cite frequently in surveys about their top concerns.
segments.tr: - **Gas prices** — Biến động tại các trạm xăng tiếp tục là vấn đề ví tiền mà cử tri thường xuyên nhắc đến trong các cuộc khảo sát về các mối quan tâm hàng đầu của họ.

segments.src: - **Affordability** — Broader cost-of-living pressures, from housing to groceries, remain a dominant theme in voter sentiment research, and incumbents of both parties are being pressed to explain what they would do differently.
segments.tr: - **Affordability** — Áp lực chi phí sinh hoạt rộng lớn hơn, từ nhà ở đến hàng tạp hóa, vẫn là một chủ đề chiếm ưu thế trong nghiên cứu tâm lý cử tri, và các đương kim nghị sĩ của cả hai đảng đang bị thúc ép phải giải thích những gì họ sẽ làm khác đi.

segments.src: Analysts caution that primary-season polling is a snapshot, not a forecast, and that the political mood can shift considerably over the eight-plus weeks remaining before Election Day.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích cảnh báo rằng các cuộc thăm dò trong mùa sơ bộ chỉ là một bức ảnh chụp nhanh, không phải là một dự báo, và tâm trạng chính trị có thể thay đổi đáng kể trong hơn tám tuần còn lại trước Ngày Bầu cử.

segments.src: Even so, the current data has prompted strategists in both parties to recalibrate their messaging.
segments.tr: Dù vậy, dữ liệu hiện tại đã thúc đẩy các nhà chiến lược ở cả hai đảng điều chỉnh lại thông điệp của họ.

segments.src: ## What's at Stake in Rhode Island and New Hampshire
segments.tr: ## Những gì đang bị đe dọa ở Đảo Rhode và New Hampshire

segments.src: Primary contests like those in Rhode Island and New Hampshire help determine which candidates will carry each party's banner into November.
segments.tr: Các cuộc đua sơ bộ như những cuộc đua ở Đảo Rhode và New Hampshire giúp xác định ứng cử viên nào sẽ mang lá cờ của mỗi đảng bước vào tháng 11.

segments.src: Turnout patterns, margins of victory, and the ideological makeup of the winning candidates can all offer clues about enthusiasm levels heading into the general election.
segments.tr: Các mô hình cử tri đi bỏ phiếu, biên độ chiến thắng và thành phần tư tưởng của các ứng cử viên chiến thắng đều có thể cung cấp manh mối về mức độ nhiệt tình khi bước vào cuộc tổng tuyển cử.

segments.src: Local election officials in both states have emphasized that they expect a smooth voting process and encourage residents to confirm their registration status and polling locations ahead of time.
segments.tr: Các quan chức bầu cử địa phương ở cả hai bang đã nhấn mạnh rằng họ kỳ vọng một quá trình bỏ phiếu suôn sẻ và khuyến khích cư dân xác nhận tình trạng đăng ký và địa điểm bỏ phiếu của họ trước.

segments.src: ## A Path Back for Democrats?
segments.tr: ## Con đường quay lại cho Đảng Dân chủ?

segments.src: Democratic strategists see an opening.
segments.tr: Các nhà chiến lược của Đảng Dân chủ thấy trước một cơ hội.

segments.src: Historically, the party that does not hold the White House tends to perform well in midterm-style cycles, and if affordability and cost-of-living concerns remain top of mind for voters, some analysts believe that dynamic could help Democrats in competitive House and Senate races.
segments.tr: Trong lịch sử, đảng không nắm giữ Tòa Bạch Ốc thường có xu hướng thể hiện tốt trong các chu kỳ kiểu bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ, và nếu khả năng chi trả và các mối quan tâm về chi phí sinh hoạt vẫn là ưu tiên hàng đầu của cử tri, một số nhà phân tích tin rằng động lực đó có thể giúp Đảng Dân chủ trong các cuộc đua Hạ viện và Thượng viện cạnh tranh.

segments.src: Retaking either chamber would require winning a mix of suburban swing districts and a handful of closely contested Senate seats — no small task, and one that will depend heavily on candidate quality, fundraising, and turnout operations in the final stretch.
segments.tr: Việc chiếm lại một trong hai viện sẽ đòi hỏi phải giành chiến thắng trong sự kết hợp giữa các quận dao động ngoại ô và một số ít ghế Thượng viện cạnh tranh sát nút — không phải là một nhiệm vụ nhỏ, và là một nhiệm vụ sẽ phụ thuộc rất nhiều vào chất lượng ứng cử viên, gây quỹ và các hoạt động vận động cử tri đi bỏ phiếu trong chặng đua cuối cùng.

segments.src: Republican leaders, for their part, argue that two months is a long time in politics and that the economic picture, along with developments overseas, could look different by early November.
segments.tr: Các nhà lãnh đạo Đảng Cộng hòa, về phần mình, lập luận rằng hai tháng là một khoảng thời gian dài trong chính trị và bức tranh kinh tế, cùng với các diễn biến ở nước ngoài, có thể trông khác vào đầu tháng 11.

segments.src: Party officials say they are focusing their closing argument on the broader economy and national security.
segments.tr: Các quan chức đảng cho biết họ đang tập trung lập luận kết thúc của mình vào nền kinh tế rộng lớn hơn và an ninh quốc gia.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Những gì cần theo dõi tiếp theo

segments.src: As the calendar moves toward November, expect:
segments.tr: Khi lịch tiến về tháng 11, hãy mong đợi:

segments.src: 1. Additional state primaries that will finalize the general-election matchups in contested districts.
segments.tr: 1. Các cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ cấp bang bổ sung sẽ hoàn thiện các trận đấu tổng tuyển cử ở các quận có sự cạnh tranh.

segments.src: 2. Continued economic data releases on inflation, gas prices, and consumer sentiment that could shape the debate over affordability.
segments.tr: 2. Việc tiếp tục công bố dữ liệu kinh tế về lạm phát, giá khí đốt và tâm lý người tiêu dùng có thể định hình cuộc tranh luận về khả năng chi trả.

segments.src: 3. Updates on the situation involving Iran, which both parties acknowledge could influence how voters view foreign policy leadership.
segments.tr: 3. Cập nhật về tình hình liên quan đến Iran, mà cả hai đảng đều thừa nhận có thể ảnh hưởng đến cách cử tri nhìn nhận về sự lãnh đạo chính sách đối ngoại.

segments.src: 4. A steady stream of new polling as campaigns enter their final push.
segments.tr: 4. Một luồng ổn định các cuộc thăm dò mới khi các chiến dịch bước vào đợt đẩy nước rút cuối cùng.

segments.src: Voters in Rhode Island, New Hampshire, and every other state will ultimately decide the outcome.
segments.tr: Cử tri ở Đảo Rhode, New Hampshire và mọi bang khác cuối cùng sẽ quyết định kết quả.

segments.src: For now, both parties are treating the next two months as a critical window to make their case on the economy, national security, and the day-to-day cost pressures facing American households.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, cả hai đảng đều đang đối xử với hai tháng tới như một cửa sổ quan trọng để đưa ra lập luận của họ về nền kinh tế, an ninh quốc gia và áp lực chi phí hàng ngày mà các hộ gia đình Mỹ phải đối mặt.
